purpose: Every official Battlefield 6 game update after the upstream-declared dataset baseline, with the combat-relevant deltas each one introduced and a deterministic check for whether the current repository dataset represents it. This ledger is the evidence for verifiedCombatVersion; that value is earned here, never copied from the live game version.
baselineNote: The upstream source metadata declares a 1.3.3.0 baseline, but the snapshot was retrieved on 2026-07-25, after 1.4.1.0 shipped on 2026-07-16. The declared baseline is therefore stale metadata rather than a true content ceiling. Upstream provenance is left untouched; actual coverage is demonstrated per-delta below.

checkTypes.weaponPresent: A source weapon record with this id (or alias) must exist in data/weapons.json.
checkTypes.attachmentCompat: The named weapon must list the named attachment id in the named compatibility slot.
checkTypes.attachmentPresent: An attachment record with this id must exist in the named catalog.
checkTypes.overlayRule: app.js must contain the named explicit verified overlay token.
checkTypes.notModelled: The mechanic is outside this application's combat model by design; recorded for completeness and non-blocking.
checkTypes.valuesUnpublished: EA changed a combat value but published no numbers, and the current snapshot predates the change. Cannot be verified deterministically; blocks promotion.
checkTypes.numericWeaponStatDelta: Whether the patch changed any NUMERIC weapon statistic this project models. false requires the official changelog to have been fetched and read in full, with every weapon-affecting line classified. It is the bridge that lets values attested by a source at an older version be claimed current for the live game, so it is never inferred from silence.
checkTypes.sourceOverlay: A published numeric change that IS now represented, carried by a versioned entry in data/source-overlays.json on top of the pristine upstream mirror. The check names the overlay and the weapons it covers; scripts/audit-source-overlay.mjs proves the values are attributable to the frozen source capture.
checkTypes.mechanicRemoved: A patch that REMOVED an effect. The correct post-patch behaviour is "no effect", so the model represents the patch when the named attachments carry none of the named modifier fields. This is the one case where absence is positive evidence, because the patch itself establishes that absence is the right post-state. It is never a licence to argue away an unmodelled effect the patch did not remove.

changes.description: VSSM DMR added, integrated suppressor, subsonic ammunition, full-auto capability.
Extended Barrel added for M87A1, M1014, 18.5KS-K and DB-12; increases projectile velocity at the cost of mobility and ADS speed.

check.reason: This project models optics as coarse range-fit tiers, not named scopes. That is a pre-existing documented modelling boundary (README v2.1), not dataset staleness: the upstream feed exposes no named-scope table at any version. A named LPVO maps onto the existing variable-magnification tier policy.

changes.description: Bullets lose damage travelling through water and may deal no damage after travelling far enough underwater.

check.reason: The optimizer ranks land engagements at an exact horizontal distance and models no water medium. No ranked value can depend on this.

changes.description: REDSEC Grenadier trait HE ammo 5 to 4; Cluster Munitions submunitions 6 to 3, blast damage 30 to 20, radius 2m to 1.5m.

check.reason: Underbarrel launcher gadget balance. Not a primary/secondary firearm in the weapon optimizer and not part of any ranked value.

patches.numericWeaponStatDeltaEvidence: Added three weapons (BROD 3, EF88, VSSM) and the Extended Barrel for four shotguns. New weapon records are numeric weapon data by definition.

changes.description: The 1P86 Variable Scope can no longer be used while operating an underbarrel launcher.

check.reason: The model has no underbarrel-launcher equipped state, so this restriction cannot change any ranked value.

changes.description: Underbarrel attachment models on the M123K now update correctly when changing the equipped underbarrel attachment.

check.reason: Cosmetic model update; no combat value.

patches.numericWeaponStatDeltaEvidence: Official changelog fetched and read in full. Its only two lines are the 1P86 scope being unusable while operating an underbarrel launcher, and an M123K underbarrel MODEL update. Neither is a numeric weapon statistic.

changes.description: Interdictor Sniper Rifle added; longest-range sniper in Battlefield 6.
Match Grade Ammo on the M2010 ESR and SVK-8.6 no longer applies unintended damage reductions; also now deals intended damage against swimming soldiers.

check.reason: EA corrected a damage interaction but published no resulting values, and the current snapshot predates the patch. The ammo record exposes no damage-reduction field to compare against, so representation cannot be established deterministically.

changes.description: An unintended recoil modifier has been removed from VSSM barrel attachments.

check.reason: RESOLVED 2026-09-05, structurally. EA removed a recoil modifier from the VSSM barrel attachments, so the correct post-1.4.2.0 behaviour is that those barrels apply none. The upstream simulator sums its ADS recoil terms over GRIP, MUZZLE, AMMO and ERGO only (sim/applyAttachments.js totalAdsRecoilTierMod and totalAdsVarTierMod); the BARREL slot contributes no recoil term anywhere in the pipeline, and no BARRELS record in the catalog carries a recoil field. The post-patch state is therefore what the model computes. This says nothing about any effect the patch did NOT remove.

changes.description: VSSM limb damage multipliers have been adjusted.

check.reason: No values published. Limb multipliers do not enter the chest-based ranking, but they do drive the displayed low-body figures, so the delta is still unrepresented.

changes.description: Weapon statistics updates for EF88, BROD and VSSM.

check.reason: RESOLVED 2026-09-05. EA published no numbers, but sym.gg did, and its 1.4.2.0 dump is publicly carried by the SheetOnMyFace workbook. 35 primitive values plus 4 derived follow-ups across these three weapons are now ingested through overlay sym-1.4.2.0. The workbook archives its own 1.3.3.0 rows, which match our mirror on 3630/3630 mapped comparisons, so its version labelling is demonstrably faithful.

changes.description: Sniper rifles on non-Recon classes transition into ADS more smoothly and apply the intended aim offset immediately, preserving the intended quickscoping penalty.

check.reason: ADS transition smoothing and aim offset are not inputs to damage, BTK, TTK, recoil-index or optic-fit ranking.

patches.numericWeaponStatDeltaEvidence: Official changelog states "Weapon statistics updates for EF88, BROD and VSSM". Those numeric changes are now ingested from the Sym 1.4.2.0 dump via data/source-overlays.json.

changes.description: The Match Trigger attachment no longer affects fully automatic fire on the BROD and EF88.
changes.note: Implemented as an explicit verified overlay rather than waiting for the upstream snapshot: the rule is a hard exclusion, not a numeric value, so it can be represented exactly.

patches.numericWeaponStatDeltaEvidence: Official changelog fetched in full from EA on 2026-09-05 and every line classified. The entire WEAPONS section is one line: "The Match Trigger attachment no longer affects fully automatic fire on the BROD and EF88" - an attachment LEGALITY rule, not a number, and already represented exactly by the BLOCKED_UNTIL_PATCH overlay in app.js. Every other line is player/party UI, helicopter miniguns vs swimming soldiers, laser designation on two jets, grenade edge indicators, the EOD Bot Arm reclassified as light melee, UI/HUD black screens, Portal lobby reliability, AI boat behaviour on Wake Island, server water processing, and two REDSEC map/mode fixes. None touches a modelled weapon statistic; melee gadgets and vehicles are outside the primary/secondary firearm model entirely.
